# Dependency Map — Member Integration Processes

## Document metadata

- **Space:** INTEGOPS
- **Source status:** current
- **Last modified by:** platform.ops@example.com
- **Labels:**
    - dependency-map
    - integration
    - triage-agent
- **Source body format:** structured

## Purpose (sec-001)

This document maps member-facing actions in the MemberPortal to the integration processes they trigger, the downstream systems they affect, and the team responsible for each process. It is the primary reference for the incident triage agent when identifying which integration process to inspect for a reported issue.

## How to Use This Document (sec-002)

When a ticket arrives describing a member-facing symptom, match the symptom keywords to a Member Action below. Follow the row to identify the candidate integration process, systems involved, and owning team. Use the Process ID to query Boomi logs via the Inspect Boomi Log Tool.

## Dependency map

- **Schema version:** 1.3
- **Last reviewed:** 2024-09-01
- **Reviewed by:** integration.team@example.com
- **Note:** Mappings marked confidence=low have not been validated against production traffic. Treat as indicative only.

### Member updates employment information (dm-001)

- **Trigger keywords:**
    - employment
    - employer
    - job title
    - workplace
    - employment history
    - work details
- **Boomi process:**
    - **Name:** EmploymentUpdateListener
    - **Type:** Sub Process
    - **Environment:** Production
    - **Atom name:** IntegrationAtom-PROD
    - **Process ID:** proc-e1a2b3c4
- **Systems involved:**
    - Item 1:
        - **System:** MemberPortal
        - **Role:** source
        - **Direction:** outbound
        - **Data type:** Member employment form submission
        - **Layer:** Presentation
    - Item 2:
        - **System:** Boomi
        - **Role:** orchestrator
        - **Direction:** inbound-outbound
        - **Data type:** Transformed employment payload
        - **Layer:** Integration
    - Item 3:
        - **System:** Salesforce
        - **Role:** target
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Data type:** Contact employment fields
        - **Layer:** Application
    - Item 4:
        - **System:** NetSuite
        - **Role:** target
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Data type:** Member account employment attributes
        - **Layer:** Application
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** CRMTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** crm.support@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #crm-integrations
- **Common errors:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Error signature:** ExternalId not found
        - **Likely cause:** Member record does not exist in Salesforce
        - **Resolution type:** DataFix
        - **Retry after fix:** false
    - Item 2:
        - **Error signature:** Timeout connecting to NetSuite
        - **Likely cause:** NetSuite API unavailable or slow
        - **Resolution type:** PlatformIssue
        - **Retry after fix:** true
- **Confidence:** high
- **Notes:** Most common source of member-reported integration tickets. Validated against 6 months of production logs.

## Scoped legacy screen mapping

### Professional history legacy screen (DEP-LEGACY-PROFESSIONAL)

- **Applies to:** The MemberPortal screen explicitly named Professional history legacy screen only.
- **Last reviewed:** 2023-11-15
- **Member action:** Member saves employment details through the Professional history legacy screen.
- **Boomi process:**
    - **Name:** ContactDetailsSyncProcess
    - **Process ID:** proc-h4d5e6f7
- **Systems involved:** MemberPortal, Boomi, Salesforce, NetSuite, Sitecore.
- **Owning team:** CRMTeam
- **Scope note:** This screen-specific mapping does not replace dm-001 for the current employment form or dm-004 for contact and member-profile updates.


## Prototype investigation scope

Only Sitecore, Salesforce, Boomi and NetSuite have platform-assignment support in this prototype. MemberPortal is the reporting/source application; it is not a separate assignable platform. PaymentGateway, NotificationService, EventManagementSystem and IdentityProvider remain architectural dependencies outside platform-assignment scope. Record relevant evidence and request human investigation when it points outside the supported platforms; do not substitute a supported platform merely to assign the ticket. Process ownership and platform-routing groups serve different purposes.

EventRegistrationSync (proc-g3c4d5e6), CPDDeclarationIngestion (proc-i5e6f7g8) and MemberFeedbackRouter (proc-j6f7g8h9) are recognized process candidates with no retained process articles or execution logs. An empty result is unavailable evidence, not proof of successful processing.
